basic_details.job_title: Tata Memorial Hospital Scientific Assistant Recruitment 2026 - Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: The Tata Memorial Hospital (TMH) Scientific Assistant - Sleep Lab Notification 2026 has been released on 24 July 2026 on the official website of Tata Memorial Hospital. A total of 1 vacancy has been announced through the TMH Scientific Assistant - Sleep Lab Recruitment 2026.

how_to_apply: Applications must be submitted online on or before 03-08-2026.
To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section.
Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of Tata Memorial Hospital to complete the application.
Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details.
Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format.
Pay the application fee online, if applicable.
Review all details carefully before submitting the form.
Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the Scientific Assistant - Sleep Lab post?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the online application for the Scientific Assistant - Sleep Lab position at Tata Memorial Hospital is 03-08-2026.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Scientific Assistant - Sleep Lab role?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a B.Sc degree in Science, Sleep Medicine, or Sleep Lab Technology to be eligible for this position.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for the Scientific Assistant - Sleep Lab recruitment?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for candidates applying for the Scientific Assistant - Sleep Lab post is 40 years.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Scientific Assistant - Sleep Lab position?
faq.answer: The selected candidate for the Scientific Assistant - Sleep Lab post will receive a salary of Rs. 40,000 per month.

faq.question: Q5. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, as per the notification, there is no application fee for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment.

faq.question: Q6. What is the selection process for the Scientific Assistant - Sleep Lab post?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Scientific Assistant - Sleep Lab position will be based on an Interview.

faq.question: Q7. What type of job is this recruitment?
faq.answer: This is a contract-based job opportunity at Tata Memorial Hospital.

faq.answer: Tata Memorial Hospital is located in Mumbai, Maharashtra, with the pincode 400012.
